verdicts.abstract_excerpt: A variety of codimension $c$ in complex affine space is called positively hyperbolic if the imaginary part of any point in it does not lie in any positive linear subspace of dimension $c$. Positively hyperbolic hypersurfaces are defined by stable polynomials. verdicts.title: The ring of local tropical fans and tropical nearby monodromy eigenvalues
verdicts.abstract_excerpt:
We extend the tropical intersection theory to tropicalizations of germs of analytic sets. In particular, we construct a (not entirely obvious) local version of the ring of tropical fans with a nondegenerate intersection pairing.
  As an application, we study nearby monodromy eigenvalues -- the eigenvalues of the monodromy operators of singularities, adjacent to a given singularity of a holomorphic function $f$. More precisely, we express some of such values in terms of certain resolutions of $f$
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns tropical intersection theory, monodromy eigenvalues, and the Igusa/Denef-Loeser monodromy conjectures — it never mentions local ring unit groups, communication complexity, or any rank/size bound relating them. It shares only the loose vocabulary of 'local' and 'tropical' with the conjecture.
